submission_student.title: Submit my document
submission_student.description: Send a saved version of a local document linked to your cloud slot.
submission_student.link_first: Link the document through cloud synchronization first.
submission_student.discard_description: The uploaded version remains in cloud storage. This only cancels a plan that has not been submitted.
submission_student.confirm_description: The saved content will be frozen, uploaded, and submitted for review. Close the editor first. The server uses the latest cloud version; avoid cloud changes from other devices during submission.
submission_student.version_limit: Close the editor to finish saving before submission. The server uses the latest cloud version; another device can still change the captured version during submission. The resulting snapshot is checked afterwards.
submission_student.review_pending: Review comments become available when the review is complete.

attempt.uploaded: The version is saved in cloud storage. Submission is not confirmed. Retry using this saved version; later local edits will not be uploaded.
attempt.uncertain: The submission outcome is unknown. Check history first; the application will not submit again while the result is uncertain.
attempt.unverified: The server confirmed a submission, but its snapshot could not be verified. Check again without creating another submission.
attempt.submitted: Submission confirmed. The server snapshot matches the prepared version.
attempt.mismatch: A submission exists, but the server snapshot differs from the prepared version. Open the snapshot to inspect the version actually submitted. Wait for review completion before another submission.

errors.active_submission: A submission is waiting for review or being reviewed. Wait for review completion.
errors.invalid_document: Complete the title and chapter content; the server account must provide the author name and student number. The server may also reject an invalid archive.
errors.not_linked: This document is not linked to the account cloud slot. Synchronize it first.
errors.pending_attempt: Complete or check the previous submission attempt first.
errors.check_history: The outcome is uncertain. Use Check submission outcome; resubmission is disabled to avoid duplicates.
errors.cloud_changed: The cloud version has changed. It will not be submitted automatically. Cancel this plan, inspect cloud storage, and prepare a new submission.
errors.cloud_conflict: The cloud version changed since the draft base. Resolve the conflict in Cloud documents before submitting.
errors.kp_unsupported: Online internship submission is not supported by the server. Local documents remain available.
errors.editor_open: Close the document editor first to finish saving.
errors.forbidden: This account cannot submit this document. Check permissions and email verification.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.session_changed: The account or server changed. Reload the submission page.
errors.integrity_failed: The server snapshot failed hash verification. Check again before considering the submission successful.
errors.not_found: The server document or snapshot is unavailable.
errors.invalid_response: The server response does not match the contract. Check the outcome before retrying.
errors.request_failed: The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and submission status before retrying.
errors.pending_missing: There is no saved submission plan for this account and server.
errors.academic_changed: Server academic data changed or has not been applied to the package. Prepare the version again using current server data.
errors.academic_invalid: Server academic data does not match the contract. Check advisor/examiner assignments and university data.
errors.academic_scope: This document is linked to another account, server, or cloud document. Use a separate local copy for this account.

cloud_academic.readonly: Author, advisors, examiners, program head and dean are filled automatically from the server and cannot be edited on cloud documents.
cloud_academic.unavailable: Cloud author and academic fields remain locked. Server data is unavailable; the last saved values are retained. Check the connection or owning account, then reopen settings.
cloud_academic.missing: The server author record is incomplete. Update it through the academic data administrator; cloud author fields cannot be filled manually.
